name: Elena Quispe Mendoza
bio:
Elena's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After earning her degree in electrical engineering from the Universidad Nacional de Ingeniería in Lima, she initially worked on industrial automation projects. A chance encounter with a small racing team needing help troubleshooting engine control systems ignited a passion she never knew she possessed.

Elena is a pragmatic and methodical engineer. She believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing sensor readings and control algorithms to optimize performance. While relatively new to the high-stakes world of professional racing, her unwavering focus on detail and her ability to rapidly diagnose electrical issues make her a valuable asset. Her Peruvian roots instilled in her a resourceful and adaptable mindset, ready to tackle any challenge thrown her way.

What sets Elena apart is her quiet determination. She is comfortable working independently, often disappearing into the garage late at night to pore over schematics and troubleshoot problems. She's not one for grand pronouncements, but her solutions speak for themselves.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Elena is a woman of medium build, with a focused gaze and a practical demeanor that reflects her engineering mindset.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with hand-drawn circuit diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on using a specific brand of multimeter, claiming it's 'the only one that gives accurate readings'.
